selection: FULL fine-tune of the public Raptor maxspan checkpoint (dreaddevelopment raptor_ft_coatnet_v5_full_swa.pt, CoAtNet-2 at 384 px) on the Gemini v1 labels: all four CoAtNet stages trainable, plain soft-label BCE, GPU augmentation, no teacher distillation, 10 epochs, encoder LR 1e-5 / head 1e-4 with 10% warmup and cosine decay, gradient checkpointing. model38 - the maxspan arm in our 0.943 blend - trained only the LAST stage for 2 epochs at LR 5e-6 with distillation and confidence-weighted BCE (gold 0.9254; head retrain on full bags then 0.9308). Every LB gain this project has had came from better Raptor weights (+0.001 per step), so a genuine full adaptation is the next step of that ladder. The untouched public checkpoint is the epoch-0 candidate, and the epoch is chosen by weak-val BCE, so a harmful fine-tune cannot be selected.
